definitions.gloss: fish paste; surimi; ground fish meat
definitions.explanation: minced or ground fish paste used as a base ingredient for various processed seafood products like kamaboko, chikuwa, and imitation crab

examples.japanese: すり{身|み}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{団子|だんご}→団子：04959_dango⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦カニカマ→カニカマ：10793_kanikama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すり{身|み}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{作|つく}られる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Imitation crab is made from surimi.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{身|み}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
FOOD TERM:
すり{身|み} is the base ingredient for many traditional Japanese fish products. The word has been adopted internationally as 'surimi.'

PRODUCTS MADE FROM すり{身|み}:
- {蒲鉾|かまぼこ} - kamaboko (fish cake)
- ⟦ちくわ→ちくわ：07479_chikuwa⟧ - chikuwa (tube-shaped fish cake)
- ⟦さつま{揚|あ}げ→さつま揚げ：07974_satsumaage⟧ - satsuma-age (fried fish cake)
- ⟦カニカマ→カニカマ：10793_kanikama⟧ - imitation crab
- ⟦{魚肉|ぎょにく}→魚肉：23922_gyoniku⟧⟦ソーセージ→ソーセージ：11027_sooseeji⟧ - fish sausage
- ⟦はんぺん→はんぺん：21733_hanpen⟧ - hanpen (white fish cake)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- すり{身|み}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to grind into paste
- ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧すり{身|み} - fish paste
- ⟦{白身|しろみ}{魚|ざかな}→白身魚：21114_shiromizakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧すり{身|み} - white fish surimi

PROCESS:
⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すりつぶす → washing → mixing → shaping
